日文.首段:
南海20000系電車（なんかい20000けいでんしゃ）は、南海電気鉄道高野線の特急「こうや号」（現・「こうや」）用に在籍していた専用車両。
「ズームカー」こと21001系の特急版ということで｢デラックスズームカー｣と呼ばれた。

章节.概要:
南海高野線では、1952年より1251形・クハ1900号を使って特急「こうや号」の運行が開始された。しかし、1958年に21001系ズームカーが登場すると性能的に見劣りがするようになったため、21001系をベースにサービス設備面をグレードアップした特急専用車両を製作することになり、1961年に堺の帝国車両で製造された。
編成は難波寄りからモハ20001（A号車）-モハ20100（B号車）-サハ20801（C号車）-モハ20002（D号車）で、機器の基本設計は21001系に準じるが、全電動車方式であった21001系に対し、本系列は冷房電源を供給する大容量電動発電機とトイレ・洗面所用水タンクの装備スペースを床下に確保するため、1両は付随車となっている。それでも定員乗車が原則の有料座席指定特急でのみ運用されたため、山岳区間での運行には全く支障がなかった。
章节.車体:
新造当時一般的な普通鋼による準張殻構造の17m級車体を備える。
窓配置は20001・20002が運転台寄りから1D61、20100が1D61、20801がd15D1（d：業務用扉、D：客用扉）で、シートピッチに合わせて幅1,750mm×高さ800mmの大形複層ガラスを客用窓とした。なお、各車共に2枚折戸による客用扉が設けられた側と反対側車端部に約半分の幅の側窓が設けられているが、これは非常時の脱出用や冷房故障時等の換気用を兼ねた下降窓とされていた。両先頭車運転台横にも、曲角の下降窓があったが、これは運転開始の時点では一部に通票閉塞の区間が残っていたためである。20801には難波寄りに業務用扉（非常用を兼ねる）が設けられているが、これはこの位置に車内販売などを行うサービスコーナーが設けられており、その資材出し入れのために用意されたものであった。また塗装はクリームイエローとワインレッドのツートンカラーという独自の物が採用された。
エクステリアデザインは、スイス連邦鉄道（SBB、スイス国鉄）のTEE用電車であるRAe TEEII形電車を意識してデザインされたと伝えられ、左右の腰部に各1灯、屋根中央部に1灯の合計3つのシールドビームが設けられた前照灯の配置や、乗務員扉を持たない流線型の前頭部の造形、それに塗色などにその影響が認められる。その独特で複雑な造形の流線型前頭部は全て熟練職人の手による叩き出しで仕上げられており、国鉄80系電車の製造でも抜群の仕上がりの良さを賞賛された、帝国車両の車体製造技術の粋を集めた作品であった。
インテリアデザインは、髙島屋が担当し、光天井方式と南海伝統の読書灯を併用する落ち着いた中に高級感のある優れた意匠とされ、座席は当時の国鉄の一等車並みのリクライニングシートを採用、シートピッチは1050mmである。また、通路の扉はオレンジがかった色味の透明アクリル製マジックドア（自動扉）が採用されていた。
章节.電装品:
21001系と共通の東洋電機製造製TDK-820-B（端子電圧300V時定格出力70kW 265A/1,300rpm/4,500rpm）を装備し、駆動装置も同じく東洋電機製造が開発した中空軸平行カルダン駆動方式、制御器についても当初は東洋電機製造ACD-10を採用した。ただし、特急用ゆえに平坦線での高速走行性能が重視され、最大弱め界磁率は21001系の25%から22%に引き上げられていた。性能は加速度3.0km/h/s、減速度3.5km/h/s　釣合速度は100km/hである。100km/hを超えると自動的に強界磁段68％にノッチが入り、電動機の許容回転数を越えないような機構も備えている。
また、集電装置は通常の菱形パンタグラフが20001・20002の運転台寄りと20100の難波寄りに設けられていた。
章节.台車: 21001系の住友金属工業 FS-317Aをベースに、枕ばねをエリゴ形空気ばねに置き換えた、住友金属工業FS-338一体鋳鋼ウィングばね台車を装着する。この台車はベローズ式の空気ばねを挟んで上下2つの揺れ枕を備え、ボルスタアンカーが上揺れ枕と台車側枠を連結する、第一世代の空気ばね台車であるが、一体鋳鋼製側枠ゆえの高剛性と高野線の軌道条件に合わせて入念に調整されたばね定数設定により、特急車に相応しい乗り心地を実現していた。
章节.ブレーキ: 発電ブレーキと空気ブレーキの同期動作を行う三菱電機HSC-D発電制動併用電磁直通ブレーキが採用されており、発電制動は同時代の21001系と同じ制御段数となっていた。
章节.冷房装置: 冷凍能力4,000kcal/hの東芝製分散式冷房装置が各車5基ずつ搭載されており（分散式ではあるが、キセは連続形になっていた）、これに給電する電源として、20801の床下に大容量電動発電機が装架されていた。
章节.運用:
本系列は十分に吟味した材料や部品を使用し、製造コストが高騰したこともあって僅かに4連1編成が製造されたに留まった。このため、閑散期である冬季は定期検査を行う必要から全列車運休となっていた。冬期以外でも臨時検査時には運休となり、代走及び夏期などの多客時の増発として21001系クロスシート車による「臨時こうや号」が運転されるケースがしばしばあった。
1973年10月7日の高野線昇圧時には、それに先立つ9月末で同年内の営業運転を終了、冬期検査と併せた改造工事が実施された。奇数M車構成であったため、1C8M制御方式のMM'構成として改造された21001系とは異なり単車昇圧が実施され、主電動機（TDK-820-D）や主制御器といった主要機器を1,500V専用で製作された新品と交換した。
1977年に高野山で行われた全国植樹祭では、国鉄和歌山線との接続駅である橋本駅 - 極楽橋駅間で昭和天皇のお召し列車としての役割を担った。
1983年の弘法大師ご入定1150年御遠忌に伴う輸送力増強が計画された際には、新造から四半世紀が近づき老朽化が目立ち始めたことから、当初本系列に更新工事を実施して延命することが検討された。だが、最終的には輸送力増強のために本系列代替を目的とした後継車として30000系2編成の新造が決定された。
30000系の竣工後、本系列は定期運用を同系列に譲り、御遠忌のスケジュールにあわせて随時運行された「臨時こうや号」として使用された。1984年9月15日・16日にさよなら運転が行われ、翌日の17日付で休車となり、1985年1月に廃車された。
廃車後中間車2両は解体されたが、先頭車2両はみさき公園内で静態保存された。車内の座席を撤去し、当初は「南海の歩み記念史列車館」として、南海ホークス（現：福岡ソフトバンクホークス）のダイエーへの売却後は「ホークス記念館」として使用されたが、露天での保存で車体の傷みが進行したこともあり、1994年に解体された。先頭車前面の愛称板部分が愛好家の手によって残され、2009年に天理参考館へ収蔵されている。

中文.首段:
相鐵20000系電聯車（日語：相鉄20000系電車／そうてつ20000けいでんしゃ，羅馬化：Sōtetsu 20000-kei densha）是相模鐵道於2018年2月11日投入服務的列車。這款列車的設計公佈於2017年6月5日，主要用於神奈川東部方面線和相鐵·東急直通線，替代7000系電聯車。相鐵20000系電聯車也是相鐵第一款獲得桂冠獎的列車，亦獲得了優良設計獎。相鐵20000系電聯車由日立製作所笠戶事業所生產。
相鐵20000系電聯車的第一編成啟用於2017財年，是相鐵在新款9000系電聯車之後第二個獲得優良設計獎的列車。2019年，這款列車獲得了鐵道友之會的桂冠獎，是相鐵第一款獲得桂冠獎的列車。
21000系是該款列車的派生款式，用於直通東急目黑線，8輛編成。其外觀和內飾和20000系基本相同。

== 參見 ==

英文.首段: The Nankai 20000 series (Japanese: 南海20000系電車) was a dedicated train type that was in service for the limited express “Kōya” (formerly “Kōya-gō”) on the Kōya Line of Nankai Electric Railway. Because it was a limited-express version of the 21001 series “Zoom Car,” it was called the “Deluxe Zoom Car.”

章节.Overview:
On the Nankai Kōya Line, operation of the limited express “Kōya-gō” began in 1952 using the 1251 type and KuHa 1900. However, when the 21001 series Zoom Car appeared in 1958, the older trains became inferior in performance, so it was decided to build a limited-express dedicated train based on the 21001 series with upgraded service facilities, and it was manufactured in 1961 by Teikoku Sharyō in Sakai.
The formation, from the Namba end, was MoHa 20001 (car A) – MoHa 20100 (car B) – SaHa 20801 (car C) – MoHa 20002 (car D). The basic design of the equipment followed the 21001 series, but whereas the 21001 series was an all-motor-car design, this series had one trailer car in order to secure space under the floor for a large-capacity motor-generator supplying the air-conditioning power and for the toilet/washroom water tank. Even so, since it was operated only on reserved-seat limited expresses with a fixed capacity principle, there was no problem at all in operation on mountain sections.
章节.Body:
It had a 17 m class body with a semi-monocoque structure of ordinary steel, which was common at the time of construction.
As for window arrangement, 20001 and 20002 had 1D61 from the cab end, 20100 had 1D61, and 20801 had d15D1 (d: service door, D: passenger door). Large double-glazed glass 1,750 mm wide × 800 mm high matched to the seat pitch was used for the passenger windows. In addition, on each car, at the car end opposite the side with the two-leaf folding passenger doors, a side window about half the width was provided; this was a drop window that served both as an emergency escape and for ventilation when the air conditioning failed. Both head cars also had curved drop windows beside the cab, because at the time operation began some sections still used the tablet/token block system. Car 20801 had a service door (also serving as an emergency door) on the Namba end; this was provided because a service corner for on-board sales was located there, for bringing materials in and out. The livery adopted was a unique two-tone of cream yellow and wine red.
The exterior design is said to have been consciously designed after the RAe TEE II electric train of the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB), a TEE train. This influence can be seen in the arrangement of the headlights — three sealed beams in total, one on each side at waist height and one at the center of the roof — in the streamlined front-end styling without a crew door, and in the paint colors. The distinctive, complex streamlined front end was entirely finished by hand hammering by skilled craftsmen, and it was a work that gathered the essence of Teikoku Sharyō’s carbody manufacturing technology, which had also been praised for the outstanding finish in the manufacture of JNR 80 series trains.
The interior design was handled by Takashimaya, and it was regarded as an excellent design with a sense of luxury amid calm, combining a luminous ceiling system with Nankai’s traditional reading lamps. The seats adopted reclining seats comparable to first-class cars of JNR at the time, with a seat pitch of 1,050 mm. The aisle doors used transparent acrylic “magic doors” (automatic doors) with an orange-tinted color.
章节.Electrical Equipment:
It was equipped with the TDK-820-B made by Toyo Denki Seizo (rated output 70 kW at terminal voltage 300 V, 265 A / 1,300 rpm / 4,500 rpm), common with the 21001 series; the drive system was also the hollow-shaft parallel Cardan drive developed by Toyo Denki Seizo, and the controller initially adopted the Toyo Denki Seizo ACD-10 as well. However, because it was for limited express use, high-speed running performance on flat lines was emphasized, and the maximum field-weakening ratio was raised from 25% of the 21001 series to 22%. Performance was acceleration 3.0 km/h/s, deceleration 3.5 km/h/s, and balancing speed 100 km/h. When exceeding 100 km/h, a notch automatically engaged the strong field step of 68%, and a mechanism was provided to keep from exceeding the motor’s allowable rotational speed.
As for current collectors, ordinary diamond-shaped pantographs were provided on the cab ends of 20001 and 20002 and on the Namba end of 20100.
章节.Bogies: Based on the Sumitomo Metal Industries FS-317A of the 21001 series but with the bolster springs replaced by air springs of the “Eligo” type, it was fitted with the Sumitomo Metal Industries FS-338 one-piece cast steel wing-spring bogie. This bogie was a first-generation air-spring bogie with two bolster beams (upper and lower) sandwiching a bellows-type air spring and with a bolster anchor connecting the upper bolster and the bogie side frame; thanks to the high rigidity of the one-piece cast steel side frame and carefully tuned spring constants matched to the track conditions of the Kōya Line, it achieved ride comfort befitting a limited express car.
章节.Brakes: It adopted the Mitsubishi Electric HSC-D electro-magnetic direct brake combined with dynamic braking, which synchronizes dynamic and air braking, and the dynamic braking had the same number of control steps as the contemporary 21001 series.
章节.Air Conditioning: Five Toshiba distributed-type air-conditioning units with a refrigeration capacity of 4,000 kcal/h were installed per car (though distributed, the housings were of a continuous type), and a large-capacity motor-generator was mounted under the floor of 20801 as the power source feeding them.
章节.Operation:
This series used carefully selected materials and parts, and because manufacturing costs rose, only a single four-car formation was built. For this reason, during the off-season winter, all trains were suspended because periodic inspection had to be performed. Even outside winter, it was suspended during special inspections, and it was often the case that a “temporary Kōya-gō” using cross-seat cars of the 21001 series was operated as a substitute or as an extra during busy periods such as summer.
When the Kōya Line was voltage-increased on October 7, 1973, it ended commercial operation within that year at the end of September prior to that, and modification work combined with the winter inspection was carried out. Because it had an odd-numbered M-car configuration, unlike the 21001 series which was modified to an MM′ configuration with the 1C8M control method, individual-car voltage increase was carried out, and main equipment such as the main motor (TDK-820-D) and main controller were replaced with new items manufactured exclusively for 1,500 V.
At the National Arbor Day held at Mount Kōya in 1977, it served as the imperial train for Emperor Shōwa between Hashimoto Station and Gokurakubashi Station, the connecting stations with the JNR Wakayama Line.
When transport capacity reinforcement was planned for the 1150th memorial of Kōbō Daishi’s entering nirvana in 1983, since nearly a quarter century had passed since construction and aging was becoming noticeable, it was initially considered to carry out renewal work on this series to extend its life. However, ultimately, it was decided to build two new formations of the 30000 series as successor trains intended to replace this series in order to reinforce transport capacity.
After the completion of the 30000 series, this series handed over regular operation to that series and was used as a “temporary Kōya-gō” operated as needed according to the schedule of the memorial. Farewell runs were held on September 15 and 16, 1984, and it became a stored car as of the following day, the 17th, and was scrapped in January 1985.
After scrapping, the two intermediate cars were dismantled, but the two head cars were statically preserved in Misaki Park. The interior seats were removed, and it was initially used as the “Nankai History Memorial Train Hall,” and after the Nankai Hawks (now Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks) were sold to Daiei, as the “Hawks Memorial Hall,” but because deterioration of the body progressed due to open-air preservation, it was dismantled in 1994. The nickname plate portion of the head car’s front face was kept by enthusiasts and was housed in the Tenri Sankōkan in 2009.

Because it was a limited-express version of the 21001 series “Zoom Car,” it was called the “Deluxe Zoom Car.”

== Overview ==

On the Nankai Kōya Line, operation of the limited express “Kōya-gō” began in 1952 using the 1251 type and KuHa 1900. However, when the 21001 series Zoom Car appeared in 1958, the older trains became inferior in performance, so it was decided to build a limited-express dedicated train based on the 21001 series with upgraded service facilities, and it was manufactured in 1961 by Teikoku Sharyō in Sakai.
The formation, from the Namba end, was MoHa 20001 (car A) – MoHa 20100 (car B) – SaHa 20801 (car C) – MoHa 20002 (car D). The basic design of the equipment followed the 21001 series, but whereas the 21001 series was an all-motor-car design, this series had one trailer car in order to secure space under the floor for a large-capacity motor-generator supplying the air-conditioning power and for the toilet/washroom water tank. Even so, since it was operated only on reserved-seat limited expresses with a fixed capacity principle, there was no problem at all in operation on mountain sections.
